verdict.rationale: Mirrors documents its own npm SDK with prompt and capture hooks, a configurable per-turn timeout, and background snapshot capture. The docs also say "you or your coding agent" can write and activate corrections, which hints at programmatic control. However, the SDK only covers runtime capture and delivery, and probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/HTTP API reference, an API for creating, previewing, activating and rolling back corrections, authentication and endpoint docs, and independent corroboration.
